## Type

- [ ] `feat` new component, block or user-visible behaviour
- [ ] `fix` bug fix
- [ ] `docs`, `chore`, `ci`, `test`, `refactor` or `style`

## Checklist

- [ ] CI is green (lint, typecheck, tests, build, browser smoke)
- [ ] Touches the registry, `packages/cli` or a workflow: described below what could break for people who already installed it
- [ ] Animated component: respects `prefers-reduced-motion` and uses `transform` and `opacity` only
- [ ] Component added or changed: example, docs page and poster updated
- [ ] No new dependency, or its need, license and size are explained below
